Extensive water damage affecting structural elements (hardwood floor, drywall), large coverage area (entire basement with 2 inches depth), and high volume of ruined contents after 2 days of continuous water flow almost certainly exceeds $25,000 in damages; requires prompt professional assessment and remediation.

input.claim_summary: Sam Patel's basement flooded due to a burst water supply line under an upstairs bathroom sink that leaked for approximately two days while the policyholder was away. Damage includes approximately 2 inches of standing water across the entire basement, buckled hardwood flooring, soaked drywall up to 1 foot, and numerous ruined stored items. High-severity claim requiring immediate professional water remediation and structural assessment.
